detail.name: Tsukishiro Yanagi's Namecard
detail.desc: Get by unlocking Tsukishiro Yanagi's Mindscape: Tsukishiro Style Management
detail.desc2:
A card with the image of HSO Section 6's Deputy Chief printed on it.
A valuable card that's considered a token of Section 6's friendship and commitment to the members of the HSO. Apart from contact information, it also carefully lists various means of seeking assistance in emergencies.
